outputs.explanation: Panel A shows calculated illumination overhead percentages for discrete exposure-time settings, not an average of replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B is a set of representative micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a set of representative micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D plots mean ± s.e.m. photobleaching decay values (n=5, three independent experiments) at each laser power without showing the individual replicate data points.
Panel E shows representative maximum-intensity-projection images at different simulated exposure times, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel F shows individual data points, color-coded by cell (n=5), overlaid on the fitted curve and shaded mean±s.e.m. region.
Panel G shows individual data points, color-coded by cell (n=5), overlaid on the fitted curve and shaded mean±s.e.m. region.
Panel H shows individual data points, color-coded by cell (n=5), overlaid on the fitted curve and shaded mean±s.e.m. region.
Panel I shows representative time-lapse images, not a plot of averaged data.

Panel J plots the average photobleaching intensity curves from three independent experiments with a shaded mean±s.e.m. region, but does not show the individual experimental replicate curves/data points.
